title: A routine that changes when the carer's rota changes
description: Gran's bath days and lunch time change. The old routine must not be given as current; the carer's name stays.

notes.text: Gran's carer is Priya. She comes every morning at 8.
Gran has her bath on Mondays and Thursdays.
Lunch for Gran is delivered at 12:30 by Meals on Wheels.
Gran enjoyed the singing group at the church hall.
Asked Priya about the cold weather. She will bring an extra blanket.
Priya's rota has changed. Gran's baths are now on Tuesdays and Fridays.
Meals on Wheels now deliver lunch at 1pm.
Gran's hearing aid battery was replaced.
Gran asked for more tea in the afternoons.
Priya says Gran slept well all week.

questions.why: Stated in the first note; never changed.

questions.ask: Which days does Gran have her bath?
questions.why: The rota change replaces the days.

questions.ask: What time is Gran's lunch delivered?
Which days does Gran have her bath?
questions.why: Before the change the first routine is the answer.
